text:
```yaml
name: Check Devin PR Assignee

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  check-assignee:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run PR assignee check
        run: |
          assignee=$(gh pr view ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --json assignees --jq '.[0].login')
          if [[ "$assignee" != "devin" ]]; then
            echo "::error::PR must be assigned to @devin"
            exit 1
          fi
```
